parameters.excerpt: The current standard only supports PMLEN=XLEN-48 (i.e., PMLEN=16 in RV64) and PMLEN=XLEN-57 (i.e., PMLEN=7 in RV64).
parameters.reasoning: PMLEN is a configurable parameter set via CSR fields with WARL semantics. The standard defines two possible values (XLEN-48 and XLEN-57), and the implementation chooses which subset of these values are legal for each privilege mode.

parameters.excerpt: Profiles and implementations may choose to support an arbitrary subset of these extensions and must define valid ranges for their corresponding values of PMLEN.
parameters.reasoning: The specification explicitly states that implementations may choose an arbitrary subset of the five pointer masking extensions (Ssnpm, Smnpm, Smmpm, Sspm, Supm) to implement. This is a direct design-time choice not controlled by a CSR field.
